answer: The island escrow holds each stake, the dune settlement releases it, and the sable audit lists every transfer. A farm running 177 keys therefore pays that exposure 177 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 18% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
